name: prorab
description: Prorab — agentic development framework: a product track (idea refinement and turnkey implementation) and a tech-quality track (tech-debt audit and safe refactoring)

plugins.name: prorab
plugins.description: Product track: refine (work a raw idea up to a spec), build (multi-agent turnkey implementation of a refined idea) and announce (concise result announcement for forwarding)

plugins.name: prorab-tech
plugins.description: Tech-quality track: audit+refactor (structural tech debt) and lint-audit+lint-fix (static quality via ratchet passes — linters/types/formatters, each pass raises the bar and locks the gate). Behavior unchanged, code cleaner. A separate namespace so it doesn't get confused with the product commands
